sources.label: Morphe Patches
sources.author: JoFSlash
patch_list: Allow screenshots
Lets you take screenshots and record the screen on booking, trip and payment screens, which the app normally shows as a black image. Useful for keeping your own copy of a booking or a price.
Block tracking

Stops analytics and marketing trackers: AppsFlyer, Firebase and Google Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics, Sessions, Installations and logging, Google Tag Manager, Embrace, the ID5 advertising ID, and Booking's own C360 and "squeaks" usage re…
Check crossed-out prices

When a hotel's page shows a crossed-out "original" price, adds a line under the price that compares it with the prices saved on your phone for the same dates and guests: whether you ever saw that price, or only lower ones. Says so when the…
Compare prices

Adds a Compare prices button to the property page. It shows the price on the hotel's own website from Google Hotels next to the Booking.com price, for the same dates and guests, and links to the hotel's website.
Disable start-up promotions

Stops the sheets that pop up on the home screen when the app starts, such as campaign deals ("Black Friday Deals are now live"), Genius and sign-in offers, the co-branded credit card and wallet offers, and the full-screen sign-in page the…
Disable update and rating prompts
Stops the "update available" and "this version is no longer supported" prompts, which a patched app can't act on, and the Google Play "rate this app" card after a booking.
Follow system theme
Makes the app light or dark to match your phone, instead of always light. A theme you picked in the app's Settings still wins.
GmsCore support

Makes "Continue with Google" work through MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services. A patched app can't sign in with Google through Play services, because it is no longer signed by Booking.com. Needs MicroG-RE installed, with your Google…
Hide insurance offers

Hides the offers to add room cancellation or travel insurance in the booking form, and its extra "Protect your trip" page. Off by default: turn it on if you never want insurance offered. It only hides offers: insurance you have added still…
Hide sponsored listings
Removes the properties marked "Ad" (sponsored listings) and Google's display ads from search results. On the map, sponsored properties are shown like any other property, without the ad megaphone.
Hide upsells

Hides marketing that sells you something besides your stay: campaign banners, the "Offers" row, attraction carousels and the AI trip planner card on the home screen; Booking's promotional areas on the hotel page, in the booking form, on th…
Hide urgency messages

Hides messages that push you to book quickly, such as "We have 2 left at this price", "Only 1 room left", "Rare find" and "Last booked 2 hours ago". Useful facts, such as free cancellation or sold out, stay.
Hotel contact

Adds a Contact button to the property page with the property's address, Open in Maps and Copy address, and the phone number and email the property gives Booking.com for EU consumer law (shown when Booking.com sends them).
Label Preferred properties

Adds "pays higher commission" next to the Preferred and Preferred Plus badges in search results, on property cards and on the property page. Properties get the badge by paying Booking.com a higher commission; it isn't a quality rating.
Newest reviews first
Opens a hotel's reviews sorted newest first instead of "Most relevant". You can still pick another sort on the reviews screen.
Open links in browser

Opens links to other websites in your browser (a Custom Tab where the browser has them) instead of the app's own web view, from help, terms and privacy pages, chats, trips, wishlists and settings. Booking.com's own pages, sign-in, payment,…
Price watch

Adds a Price watch tab to the property page with a "Watch this price" button. Once a day, on Wi-Fi, the app checks the price of each stay you watch (at most 20), charts it on the tab and notifies you when it drops. Nothing is checked until…
Recent rating

Shows the average score of a hotel's reviews from the last 6 months under its name on the property page and on the reviews screen, so a hotel whose recent guests score it lower than its overall score stands out. Booking.com sends no recent…
Remember result sort

Keeps the sort you last picked for search results (such as price or review score) for new searches, instead of going back to "Our top picks", which Booking.com ranks partly by commission. Until you pick a sort, Booking.com's default stays.
Remove microphone access
Removes the microphone permission. Voice input in messages (the microphone button when you write to a property) stops working.
Remove unneeded permissions
Removes the screen recording detection permission (used only by an anti-fraud fingerprinting library) and calendar access (used only to add a flight to your calendar).
Review check

Scans the reviews already shown on a hotel's reviews screen for scam, money and booking red flags (extra charges, pay-outside-platform, not as described, bookings not honoured, fraud) and shows a small banner above the booking button. Tap…
Show full price up front

Shows the total price including the taxes and charges Booking.com adds on top, such as a city tax or cleaning fee, in search results, on the map, on the property page and in the room list, instead of a lower price followed by "+ € 12 taxes…
Show price per night

Adds the price per night ("€ 45 per night") under the total price of each search result for stays of 2 or more nights. It's the total the card shows divided by the nights, including taxes and charges when Show full price up front added the…
Stays only

Hides the Flights, Car rental, Taxi, Attractions and Flight + Hotel tabs on the home screen, for when you only book places to stay. A link to one of them shows its tab next to Stays; the bookings you have of them still show.
